scope: new reviewed bounded scalar EFSM mutations and existing user-owned pure project controls
selection: All five families, both controls, every seed and applicable method must be retained. Unsupported method domains are explicit NOT_COMPARABLE. No final --case selection.
state_scope: Explicit numeric scalar EFSM, finite action names, integer arguments [-2,2], at most eight actions per fresh trace. Public model precondition failure is a declared no-op. Arbitrary Python object inference and container append/remove semantics are unsupported.

native_parameter_units.E5: 64 fresh whole-trace proposals, 62 additional whole-trace shrink predicate calls, two witness replays; independent actual transition caps still apply.
native_parameter_units.E6: 128 actual development transitions on each side, 62 native stateful shrink transitions, two bounded witness replays. Native factory episodes are not whole-trace Oracle function callbacks and are separately reported.
native_parameter_units.NativeHypothesis: Native find with up to 128 actual fresh-factory whole-trace predicate callbacks and pure-input memoization.
native_parameter_units.NativeStateful: Native search/shrink with at most 1024 actual transitions on each side, max_examples=128 with native shrinking/replay episodes separately reported; live state transitions are never memoized and factory episodes are not capped as whole-trace function calls.
native_parameter_units.comparison: Native parameter values have different units and are not claimed equal. Independent actual transition/wall ceilings, measured first-discovery invocations and total costs define comparisons. Detection loss is disallowed.

final.native_stateful_plan: Actual RuleBasedStateMachine generates traces using public contract simulation and preconditions only; freeze before any target/Oracle callback.
final.source_molds: Fresh E6 public development cases only; E5 and E6 source molds frozen per seed before final.
final.final_targets: Separately authored different implementations and renamed action/state names with declared semantic-role correspondence. No final target source is sent to a generator.
final.public_identifiers: Neutral public API identifiers bind source and target contracts. Benchmark family IDs, expected-fault labels and development/final/control labels are evaluator-only and are not put in generator specs or initialization packets.
final.ledger: exclusive-create same-state append-only ledger; an attempted final consumes the suite even on failure; no post-result tuning or repeated final
final.complete_grid: 7 cases x 4 methods x 3 seeds = 84 attempted records; NativeStateful static controls are NOT_COMPARABLE

measurement.primary_work_unit: Actual reference plus target transition callback invocations, with the two counts also reported separately. A whole-trace function callback is not one transition.
measurement.trace_cap_scope: Development 128 whole-trace callback cap applies to actual fresh-factory whole-trace predicate APIs (NativeHypothesis/E5), not native RuleBasedStateMachine factory episodes. E6/native state-machine operations share the same hard actual transition and wall ceilings. Final frozen plans all use at most 64 whole-trace callbacks.
measurement.first_failure_calls: Sum of actually executed model and target primitive transitions at the first independently observed mismatch. Whole-trace trace callbacks and native state-machine steps remain separately reported.
measurement.wall: Parent launch-to-completion, including process/import, public IR analysis, candidate generation, simulation, solver, updates, serialization, Oracle, shrink and replay. Cleanup grace never expands the execution cap.
measurement.components: Record measured generator/IR/version-space/solver/process-serialization/Oracle/shrink/replay times when exposed; missing subdivisions remain UNKNOWN rather than inferred by subtraction.
measurement.cpu: Sum last sampled CPU for each PID/create-time identity in recursive tree; sampled lower bound, evaluator CPU not added twice.
measurement.memory: 10ms sampled maximum of live process-tree RSS sum, not true OS peak.
measurement.unique_faults: One predefined failure mechanism family once across inputs, seeds and renamed implementations; input failures never become additional independent defects.
measurement.duplicates: Within-run duplicate typed pure-trace evaluations and duplicate failing traces, with denominators exposed; no cross-seed inflation.
measurement.cache: Only fresh-factory pure whole-trace results may be memoized identically across methods. Never skip a live state-machine operation on the basis of action/argument alone.
measurement.oracle_errors: Unexpected reference/factory/projection errors are evaluator failures, never target findings. Target mismatch uses canonical JSON state outcome equality.
measurement.preconditions: Invalid action preconditions are explicit model no-ops for arbitrary typed traces; native state machines may avoid them using the same public contract. Skipped/invalid operations are reported separately.

independent_development_audits.selection: canonical ID order, include empty grammar cases, no feedback to generator
independent_development_audits.meaning: Candidate failure-membership contradictions, not proven causal laws.
independent_development_audits.transfer: Declared role/type/action/precondition/invariant correspondences and exact removal of constraints contradicted by checked clean development traces. Applicability is not proof of repeated target defects.

verdict.DISCOVERY_IMPROVED: All required supported runs complete, zero control false alerts, and E6 finds strictly more unique predefined mechanisms than every jointly supported strong baseline under the preregistered wall and primitive-transition caps. Bounded descriptive result only; not external generalization.
verdict.EFFICIENCY_IMPROVED_ONLY: No detection loss and zero control false alerts; paired median total wall <=0.80 and paired median first-failure primitive-transition invocations <=0.80 versus every jointly applicable black-box baseline, with at least three stateful families in each primary NativeHypothesis/NativeStateful stratum. Report E5 separately as well.
verdict.NO_IMPROVEMENT: Complete supported evaluation without the discovery or efficiency criteria. Saturated detection alone is not improvement.
verdict.INCONCLUSIVE: Required black-box infrastructure, controls or supported runs fail/time out, any required black-box method produces a clean-control false alert, complete-grid/freeze check fails, or fewer than three stateful families are jointly comparable.

publication.logical_boundary: Local subprocess is LOGICAL_ISOLATION_ONLY. Actual Docker enforcement is separate CI evidence. Trusted evaluator targets are not sandboxed by the generator container.
